authoredComposition.conversion: UE cm -> glTF m is (UE.X, UE.Z, UE.Y) * 0.01

validationExperiment.guard: exact stock pallet attachment component owner
validationExperiment.restore: snapshot before mutation and restore immediately after parent ValidateLocation
bypassedChecks: target hierarchy NoFabrication without component AllowFabrication

checkOriginExperiment.replaces: parent hover-derived CheckLocation minus PlacementLocation delta
checkOriginExperiment.preserved: authored slot, rotation, attachment target, inherited support/overlap/water/surface checks and collision filters

palletSupportExperiment.guard: blocking Out Hit on exact stock pallet with valid HitComponent reference-equal to AttachToComponent
palletSupportExperiment.acceptedSupport: fresh blocking pallet target plus owned snapped-slot or hit-based free placement
palletSupportExperiment.truePath: preserve the complete Setup-produced Out Hit without writes
palletSupportExperiment.preserved: overlap, water, surface policy, occupancy hypothesis, attachment target, collision filters and outside-pallet support validation

placementModes.enabled: nearest squared world distance from fresh Out Hit.ImpactPoint to four pallet-transformed authored slots; strict ties keep array order; pallet-relative identity rotation
placementModes.disabled: CalculateOffset(Out Hit.ImpactPoint, Out Hit.ImpactNormal, Offset) without TransformToGridFunc positional output; preserve parent PlacementRotation
placementModes.checkLocation: selected world placement plus pallet unit world-up times live PlacementComponent.CheckOffset
placementModes.occupancy: nearest slot is selected regardless occupied; inherited local physical overlap decides rejection

humanSeedRuntimeExperiment.placeEnablement: once-per-world SetBoolPropertyByName bAllowPlacement=true; void dispatch is not success
humanSeedRuntimeExperiment.surface: exact recognized pallet PrimitiveComponent K2_LineTraceComponent along pallet world-up at selected authored XY
humanSeedRuntimeExperiment.snapEnabled: same four authored XY cells; trace height projected along pallet world-up so trace cannot shift XY
humanSeedRuntimeExperiment.snapDisabled: raw fresh ImpactPoint and ImpactNormal; preserve inherited player rotation
humanSeedRuntimeExperiment.fallback: exact stock Default SetupLocation result when target, component, preview components, or surface trace gate fails

testSpawn.policy: one actor per manual Pressed event; no repeat, polling, automatic retry, scan, or world-load spawn

placeDiagnostic.storedActor: strong reflected LastSpawnedHumanSeed reference assigned only after a valid F6 spawn
placeDiagnostic.inspectStates: no saved actor, no VoyageItemInterface, null GetItem, exact DA_HumanSeed, or other item; actor and non-null item object paths plus friendly non-identity class display names are shown
placeDiagnostic.userPrecondition: press F9 only while holding the saved F6 Human Seed; no held-state accessor is invented
placeDiagnostic.meaning: Place return is dispatch-only; preview and the owned Seed generator callback are the downstream evidence
placeDiagnostic.excluded: no Bool readback, action injection, confirmation, scan, polling, Pod mutation, common Place patch, or stock package override

revalidateWhen: The Steam build ID, authored GLB hash, stock pallet/container geometry or defaults, exporter axis convention, or serialized mirror contract changes.
